say:2:1033342001:1.text: We might run into the Thorned Guards.
say:2:1033342001:1.source_cn: 我担心会碰到荆棘卫队。
say:2:1033342001:1.male: We might run into the Thorned Guards.
say:2:1033342001:1.female: We might run into the Thorned Guards.

say:3:1033342002:1.text: They are too busy with the refugees to pay us any attention, no?
say:3:1033342002:1.source_cn: 他们不是只驱赶难民么，应该对我们没什么影响吧。

say:4:1033342003:1.text: Let me make it clear. The Thorned Guards are sealing off the entire forest!
say:4:1033342003:1.source_cn: 我纠正一下，荆棘是要封锁丛林！

say:5:1033342004:1.text: It's not just keeping the refugees out but also preventing us from making any contact with outsiders.
say:5:1033342004:1.source_cn: 所谓的封锁自然不止是针对难民——我们也会被禁止和丛林外接触。

say:6:1033342005:1.text: Even if we could find buyers outside the forest, we would be interrogated and detained by the Thorned Guards upon our return.
say:6:1033342005:1.source_cn: 所以就算我们在丛林外卖掉货物，万一回来时遇见荆棘卫队，...

say:7:1033342006:1.text: Remember Heideman? He had said a bit too much, and they...
say:7:1033342006:1.source_cn: 你还记得海德曼吗？他不过多说了两句，结果……
